case.interpolation: Piecewise linear in WGS84 geodesic distance between adjacent nominal equatorial sites, eastward across the date line.
assumptions: Straight geodesic legs connect nominal observing sites for display; this is not an observed streamline, navigable route or selected full-current axis.
Selected levels from differing record windows are connected only as an explicitly noncontemporaneous illustrative scenario. No common-period recomputation.
Intermediate levels are unmeasured interpolation. No extrapolation west of165E or east of110W.
Source5m analysis spacing supports preserving stated anchor values; display rounding is not depth uncertainty.
No width pairing, vertical thickness or volume is inferred.
